title: Meter-to-Cash Exception Triage

engineFeatures.meaning: the feature that best separates the classes
the feature on which classes 2 and 3 barely differ
the repeat entity that must not appear on both sides of a split

label: For "Meter-to-Cash Exception Triage": Classify and route billing exceptions such as unusual reads, rejected bills and mismatched accounts so analysts fix the most costly ones first. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Code-only labels.
